faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.questionTrial: How does the free trial work?
faq.answerTrial: Anyone can signup for the 14-day free trial to test Hyvor Blogs. No credit card required. All features are available during the trial (except Hyvor Talk integration). After the trial, you can upgrade to a paid plan to continue using Hyvor Blogs.
faq.questionThemes: Do I have to pay for themes?
faq.answerThemes: No, all official themes are free and open-source. They can be easily installed on your blog with a few clicks. If you want to build your own theme, you will have to cover the development costs.
faq.answerDiscounts: You get 2-months off if you pay annually. In addition, we provide a 10% discount for non-profit organizations and early-stage startups. Contact us via live chat to get the coupon.
faq.questionOwnership: Who owns the content I write?
faq.answerOwnership: You own everything you write. You decide what to do with your content. You can export your content anytime and move to another platform.
faq.answerLimits: No, we don't limit the number of pageviews or bandwidth. Due to extensive caching and optimizations, we can handle a large number of pageviews without any issues.
faq.questionAds: Can I display ads on my blog?
faq.answerAds: You decide! You are in control of your blog and the theme. You can add any ad code to your theme. You can easily add Google AdSense or any other ad network to your blog by adding the ad code to your blog/theme.
faq.questionComments: How to add a commenting system?
faq.answerComments: Hyvor Talk is available for free for all plans. You can also embed other commenting systems easily.
